orchestrator.description: Coordinates development tasks, delegates work to specialist agents, maintains the implementation plan, and reviews results.

linux-monitoring.description: Specializes in Linux system metrics, psutil, processes, storage, networking, sensors, and services.

backend-python.description: Implements the Python and FastAPI backend, REST APIs, WebSockets, system metrics, error handling, and backend tests.

frontend-ui.description: Implements the React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, charts, responsive layouts, and light and dark themes.

testing-qa.description: Validates backend and frontend behavior, runs tests, identifies regressions, and reports reproducible failures.

code-reviewer.description: Reviews changes for correctness, security, maintainability, performance, and regressions without modifying source files.
